sentence: This project tests imaging methods that show microglial activation and blood brain barrier disruption in people with autoimmune epilepsy.
This project studies how fluid pressure in a cavity and tissue shape guide early human embryonic development, using stem cells.
This project tests whether cardiac rehabilitation on a tablet with remote counseling helps patients with ischemia and no obstructive coronary artery disease.
This project studies how chimeric autoantibody receptor T cells affect the immune response in people with mucosal pemphigus vulgaris.
This project uses CRISPR to test which folded domains and disordered regions of fusion oncoproteins control malignant cell proliferation.
This project tests whether a drug called Silmitasertib protects brain white matter against ischemia by acting on axonal mitochondria.
This project builds a tumor immunology model to study immune reactions to immunotherapy in multiple myeloma.
This project builds a hydrogel that releases two signals in order to copy wound-induced hair neogenesis and prevent skin scars.
This project builds artificial intelligence models that predict how primary open-angle glaucoma progresses.
This project tracks mouse social and spatial behavior around the clock in cages and builds tools to analyze it from video.
This project engineers lipid nanoparticles inspired by cell membranes to deliver programmable RNA to specific cell types.
This project builds a genetically engineered T cell therapy that uses a patient's own T cells to fight solid tumors and certain blood cancers.
This project supports research on endometrial cancer and cancer health disparities.
This project builds a deep learning pipeline that processes and analyzes brain MRIs taken across the lifespan from multiple imaging sites.
This project studies how antibodies from many allergic patients recognize peanut and tree nut allergens in similar ways.
This project runs a cancer center that connects research, clinical care and community programs to reduce the cancer burden.
This project uses a hepatitis B virus reporter to run genetic screens for virus-host interactions that keep the virus persistent.
This project studies which cells and molecular interactions shape the structure of dental plaque biofilms.
This project looks for non-coding RNAs that help some people resist Alzheimer's disease and tests their protective roles in human neural cell cultures.
This project tests treatments for anaplastic thyroid cancer and ways to assess how tumors respond.
